title: Scribe AI
tagline: AI agent / CLI that deploys cross chain DeFi strategies from a single prompt.
description:
Scribe AI is a cross-chain, AI-powered DeFi agent that turns natural language prompts into executable, multi-chain strategies.

A user simply types a prompt like:
“Find the best yield on stablecoins across Polygon and Gnosis and allocate my assets.”
Behind the scenes, Scribe AI runs this request through a decentralized AI agent hosted on Fluence VMs, which uses real-time market data from the 1inch API and Chainlink to assess yields and risk.

It then generates a cross-chain strategy plan, such as depositing into Beefy vaults or rebalancing to higher-APR protocols, and executes it using LayerZero’s omnichain messaging. All strategy metadata and logs are stored transparently using the 0G storage layer.
how_its_made:
Built with a frontend (React + Privy) and developer-friendly CLI (Typer + FastAPI), Scribe AI combines the best of AI, multi-chain infra, and user experience in a seamless DeFi automation platform.

This project integrates with 5+ technology partners
LayerZero (omnichain messaging)
Fluence (Agentic LLM backend)
Chainlink (oracle-driven decision making)
0G (on-chain-accessible strategy logs)
1inch API,  Hardhat , Katana , and Privy for seamless  UX
